summary: Requires the President to ensure that, starting in fiscal year 2026, the share of all federal cancer research funds spent on pediatric cancer equals the share of the U.S. population under age 18, as measured by the Census Bureau.

It does not authorize new appropriations, increase total spending, or reduce any spending; it merely directs how a portion of already-obligated research dollars must be used. Therefore it has no bearing on expanding or reducing government spending.
